title: My First Vibecoded Project Made With Opus 5.5 A Solo Superhero MMORPG
author: superpikapoo
selftext:
I'm 32, living in New York, and I've been building this by myself since Opus 5.5 came out about 6 weeks ago. It took 18 versions to get here. Even the trailer was made with Claude. The video is 10 minutes of straight gameplay.

It's a superhero MMO you play solo. Your party and raid team are AI heroes, so you can run dungeons and raids without waiting on anyone.

**How i made it**: Opus 5.5 the original prompt was something like make a superhero game with 3 different powers to choose from in a metropolis fighting enemies in a wave format. so the mmorpg aspect of it evolved as I messed around. i used Claude code on max effort with the project section. this current version was the 18th version of the game which resulted in the 6 weeks and 3b tokens. tips opus really helped with some awesome suggestions so lean on it when working through your project as its incredibly smart and creative. i would tell what i want fixed and at the end say what would you suggest next and it would give me about 5-10 solid suggestions.

**Some of what's in it**:

\- 68 powers. 30 base ones, and you can fuse two or three together into bigger ones making 4,719 builds so you can replay endlessly.

\- a city with 99 quests where you can fly, use super speed, and throw cars and buses at bad guys

\- 5 dungeons, two 10-hero raids, world bosses in the street, and a nemesis who remembers you

Since someone will ask about cost: about 3B tokens. I'm on the $100 Max plan plus a $20 Pro plan, so $120 a month. At Opus 5.5 API prices that would've been somewhere between $2k and $9k, depending on how much was cached.

The whole game is one HTML file, around 3.5MB, running in the browser.

The hardest part was balance. At one point my level 50 build was doing 400k DPS and nothing could touch me. Turns out the real challenge in an MMO is balancing difficulty.

I will continue to update this game so i will looking for feedback and what you'd like to see in the game moving forward. i already have some ideas. like making this into a real mmo so you can play with friends and other people but i dont have to funds for that yet.

First 15 levels are free in your browser: [Aftershock Online by aftershockonline](https://aftershockonline.itch.io/aftershock-online). Full game is $5.

Long term I'm hoping this gets me to Florida. Any feedback helps, even the brutal kind.
